necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency. Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these intermittent symptoms with potential arrhythmias and assess the efficacy of current rate-control management. This clinical indication supports the medical necessity of CPT 93229 despite the denial based on Reason Code CO-197.
